Automation: Rules reference · resolve effects at the table

You erase the shape with one hand and draw it again with the other. Your companion unfolds where the enemy left a gap.

Rules

Action
Maneuver
Attribute
None (no roll)
Target / range / shape
One visible summon of yours within 6 squares.
Type
Magic / Movement

Teleport the summon up to 4 squares to a visible free supported space within 6 squares of you that fits its footprint. It retains its HP, conditions, remaining duration and command history.
